name: api_client_updates_approve
_description: PLAN V1.0 Bloque 8 - POST /api/v1/client-updates/approve. action='approve' -> envia Gmail al cliente y marca sent. action='reject' -> status='failed' con motivo. Requiere JWT con rol architect/owner/super_admin.

parameters.query:
WITH ctx AS (
  SELECT set_session_context($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3) AS ok
)
SELECT u.id, u.project_id, u.tenant_id, u.week_start, u.week_end, u.summary_text,
       u.photos_referenced, u.status,
       p.name AS project_name, p.current_phase, p.location_city,
       c.name AS client_name, c.email AS client_email
FROM client_weekly_updates u
JOIN projects p ON p.id = u.project_id
JOIN clients c ON c.id = p.client_id, ctx
WHERE u.id = $4::uuid
LIMIT 1;
